title: Permit Amendment on Change Orders — Ridgeline Installation Services
content:
A change order on a Ridgeline Installation Services job that already has its permit on file means the permit must be amended, and the permit-amendment share of the change order administration fee follows the permit fee line on the contract.

**Clause.** Permit-amendment share of the change order administration fee: when a permit fee line stands on the contract dated before the change order was billed, the permit on file must be amended and the permit-amendment multiple of 1.2 applies; when the contract's permit fee line is dated on or after the change order's billing date, the later-permit multiple of 1.1 applies; a contract with no permit fee line takes a permit-amendment share of 1.

The change order administration fee is multiplied by the permit-amendment share; neither the share nor any amount formed on the way to the change order administration fee is rounded, the change order administration fee being rounded to the cent only at the end.

## Terms used

- **The permit fee line** is the line on which the municipal permit fee was billed at cost on the contract; where more than one stands, the most recent one is compared.
- **The change order's billing date** is the date of the most recent change order billing line on the contract.

| Permit fee line on the contract | Permit-amendment share |
|---|---|
| dated before the change order's billing date | 1.2 |
| dated on the change order's billing date | 1.1 |
| dated after the change order's billing date | 1.1 |
| none | 1 |

## Worked figures (hypothetical change order billed 15 July, fee of 50.00 before the share)

| Permit fee line dated | Share | Fee |
|---|---|---|
| 2 July | 1.2 | 60.00 |
| 15 July | 1.1 | 55.00 |
| 28 July | 1.1 | 55.00 |
| no permit fee line | 1 | 50.00 |
